text:
maya: quick check-in on chat API surface. ops + infra raised perf concerns about the message object shape; customers want per-message metadata and role guarantees. can we converge on a plan this sprint?

ryan: TL;DR: support a canonical messages array (role, content, metadata) and a backwards-compatible compact mode for high-throughput clients. default surface = messages.

lina: We need explicit semantics for roles. Proposal: single system message only (server-enforced), user messages are inputs, assistant messages in requests only allowed for examples/canned content and flagged as "example" in metadata.

jack: For function/tool-calling, compact mode is problematic. If a client sends a single prompt string we lose per-message tool hints and metadata (e.g., "source": "email", "expectations": "formal"). Must document failure modes: no structured tool hints, lower fidelity for rerank and structured output.

maya: Agreed. Suggested launch checklist: 1) stable JSON schema for messages; 2) SDK helpers to assemble messages from old prompt strings; 3) server-side validator with soft warnings for 1 week; 4) telemetry to capture degraded tool-call rates when using compact mode; 5) migration guide + cost examples.

ryan: On implementation: we can accept both shapes at the REST layer. If Content-Type header is application/json and payload has "messages", treat as canonical. If header is Accept: application/redwood+compact or if payload is string, treat as compact. We'll return a x-redwood-compat-warnings header when we drop metadata.

lina: For role enforcement rollout: soft warning first 72h with metrics, then reject multiple system messages unless they use the new field "system_blocks" (array) for advanced use-cases. That gives power users a path without breaking customers.

jack: Ops: can we feature-flag this per-account? Dedicated customers might need longer runway.

ops-bot: feature-flag created: chat_messages_schema_v2; rollout controls: account-level override + staging-only default = false.

maya: Excellent. Prioritization: Must-have for Beta = schema, SDK helpers (py/js), docs + migration guide, telemetry, feature-flag. Nice-to-have = automatic prompt coercion on server, x-redwood-compat-warnings header, system_blocks. Estimation: infra needs ~1.5 sprint-weeks for validator + flagging; SDKs ~1 sprint for helpers + samples.

ryan: I'll take SDKs (JS + Py) and a short sample repo demonstrating migration patterns (prompt->messages).

lina: I'll own role rules + validator logic, and draft the soft-warning message wording.

jack: Ops will wire the feature-flag and deprecation emails. Need an RFC for the compact header semantics; I'll draft and link.

maya: Next steps: jack RFC by Thu EOD, ryan SDK PR by Mon, lina telemetry schema + validator rules by Mon. Planning to run a 10-customer beta in two sprints behind the flag. If no objections we'll move forward. :party_popper:
